entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, if you look away for[n]even a single moment, the[n]order changes completely.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's hard to decide who[n]to actually go after!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We can choose anyone we want!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We should wait for now though.[n]It will surely cool off soon.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: More importantly, how are[n]things on your end, Makoto?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She may not come back[n]at all tonight.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, just think how great it'd[n]be to narrow down our targets!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Aren't you guys taking this[n]too lightly? All the pressure[n]here rests on me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To be clear, we'll all be in[n]major trouble if I fail, yes?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Don't worry. We all know you[n]can handle this, Makoto.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's leave this to Makoto. I'm sure she'll[n]be able to pull it off.
